faqs.q: Which countries do you deliver to?
faqs.a: We serve Kosovo and Albania. Delivery timing and availability are confirmed when we accept your order.
The sample shipping rate is €3.50, with free delivery for orders of €50 or more. Your checkout displays the current rate before you confirm.

faqs.q: Can I order for my business?
faqs.a: Yes. Use our wholesale form with your product needs, monthly volume and delivery location. We will prepare an offer.
Pay in cash on delivery or by bank transfer when bank details are configured. We do not accept card payments at launch.
Compare width, length and thickness on each product. Follow the packaging and appliance guidance for the task you have in mind.

faqs.q: How do I request a return?
faqs.a: Contact us with your order number, the items and the reason for the return. The team will confirm the applicable process before you send anything back.

shipping-returns.title: Delivery
shipping-returns.body: Orders are available for delivery within Kosovo and Albania. Shipping is calculated at checkout. The default is €3.50, or free from €50. Delivery dates are estimates confirmed after acceptance; they are not guaranteed until agreed.

shipping-returns.title: Returns and damaged items
shipping-returns.body: Contact the store with your order number before returning an item. Include a description and photographs for damaged goods. Statutory consumer rights remain applicable; the final return window, address and costs must be confirmed by the business before launch.

privacy.title: Information we process
privacy.body: We process contact information, account details, delivery addresses, orders and messages to provide the service. Passwords are stored as hashes. We do not collect card details. The legal data controller and contact address must be provided before launch.

privacy.title: Your choices and rights
privacy.body: You can export your data and request account deletion in Security & privacy. Required accounting records may be retained for legal obligations. Optional analytics are consent-based. The owner must publish retention periods, processor details and the appropriate privacy contact before launch.

terms.title: Purchasing from EchoFoil
terms.body: Displayed prices use EUR and include the configured VAT assumption. An order submission is a request to purchase; acceptance and stock availability are confirmed by the store. Business quotes are separate offers and are not completed retail orders.

terms.title: Using the products
terms.body: Follow the product packaging and appliance instructions. Sample specifications must be verified against the actual supplied products before sale. Legal entity details, governing law and dispute resolution terms require owner review before launch.

cookies.title: Necessary storage
cookies.body: Session cookies protect your account. Browser storage remembers your cart, wishlist, theme and cookie choices. These functions are necessary for the experience you request.

cookies.title: Optional services
cookies.body: Analytics and performance services load only after analytics consent. Google Analytics is enabled only when configured and permitted. Marketing is off by default; no marketing tracker is installed. Change your choices at any time using Cookie settings in the footer.
